summary: The people of Israel will blossom and bud and fill the earth with fruit—They will be gathered one by one and will worship the Lord.
meta_description: The people of Israel will blossom and bud and fill the earth with fruit—They will be gathered one by one and will worship the Lord.

footnotes.note1_c: IE a legendary sea monster representing the forces of chaos that opposed the Creator. See JST Rev. 12:1–17 (Appendix).
footnotes.note2_a: This song of the vineyard, about Israel, anticipates ultimate fulfillment of its destiny (vv. 2–6).
footnotes.note6_b: IE the blessings of salvation. TG Vineyard of the Lord.
footnotes.note13_a: HEB great shophar; i.e., the ram’s horn used as a ceremonial trumpet. Matt. 24:31; D&C 49:23 (23–28).
